fn main#0() null {
  block_0:
    t0 = GET /camera
    t0->vfov = 60.5
    t2 = t0->vfov
    t1 = Camera {vfov: t2}
    PATCH /camera t1
    t4 = Vec3 {x: 1, y: 2, z: 3}
    t6 = Color {r: 10, g: 20, b: 30}
    t5 = Lambertian {albedo: t6}
    t3 = Sphere {coord: t4, radius: 0.5, material: t5}
    POST /hittable t3
    t8 = Vec3 {x: 0.1, y: 0.2, z: 0.3}
    t9 = Vec3 {x: 0, y: 0, z: 0}
    t7 = Background {top: t8, bottom: t9}
    PUT /background t7
    t10 = Output {file: scene.ppm}
    PATCH /output t10
    ret null
}
